findings.description: Response.__init__ now sets self.reason from self.raw.reason, but self.raw has no value at this point in construction, so instantiating Response() raises an AttributeError.
findings.rationale: Trigger: any code calling Response() with no arguments, such as a test or a custom adapter that builds an empty Response before filling it in. Mechanism: line 793 evaluates self.raw.reason while self.raw is unset or None, which raises before the constructor finishes. Impact: the constructor crashes on a path that previously worked, so callers that create a bare Response get an exception instead of an object.
